drone.name: Security Drone
drone.guide: Security drones. CENSUS's eyes. Weak, but they swarm. Keep moving.

thug.name: Street Thug
thug.guide: Basili's crew. They smell the bounty. They hurt up close, so keep your distance.

gunner.name: Gang Gunner
gunner.guide: Gunners. They shoot from range. The rounds are slow, so sidestep and take them out first.

psycho.name: Cyberpsycho
psycho.guide: Psychos. Chrome-crazed, they bite anyone. When one pauses it lunges, so dash sideways.

trooper_tank.name: Riot Tank
trooper_tank.guide: Black Shield tank. Pushes in behind a shield. Toughest of the squad; save it for last.

trooper_melee.name: Riot Striker
trooper_melee.guide: Squad melee. When the red line shows, it charges. Get off the line.

trooper_hacker.name: Riot Hacker
trooper_hacker.guide: Squad hacker. Hides behind the tank and slows you down. Cut it off first.

trooper_sniper.name: Riot Sniper
trooper_sniper.guide: Squad sniper. One heavy shot from far away. When the aim line shows, move.

kamikaze.name: Kamikaze Drone
kamikaze.guide: Suicide drones. They blink, then blow. When one starts blinking, get away.

sniper_turret.name: Sniper Turret
sniper_turret.guide: Sniper turrets. When the red line shows, a shot is coming. Step off the line.

corrupt_cop.name: Corrupt Cop
corrupt_cop.guide: Dirty cops on Basili's payroll. They fire three shells in a fan. Don't stand in front.

sec_bot.name: Security Bot
sec_bot.guide: Factory security bots. Slow, tough, hit hard. Don't get close; whittle them down.

glitch_ghost.name: Glitch Ghost AI
glitch_ghost.guide: A phantom CENSUS projects. It teleports behind you. When it vanishes, look around.

rat_bot.name: Rat Bot
rat_bot.guide: Scrap collectors. They're here to strip your secondhand chrome. Fast but fragile.

c_mirror.name: Mirror Trooper
c_mirror.guide: Mirror trooper. CENSUS learned your gunplay. Bullets barely work; use something else.

c_insulator.name: Insulator Unit
c_insulator.guide: Insulator. Electricity won't pass, and chain lightning stops here.

c_dampener.name: Blast Dampener
c_dampener.guide: Dampener. It eats explosions. Hit it with something else.

c_thorn.name: Thorn Knight
c_thorn.guide: Thorn trooper. Cut it and you get cut. Deal with it from range.

c_prism.name: Refraction Prism
c_prism.guide: Prism. Bends beams and EMP. Even the railgun stops here.

c_firewall.name: Firewall Drone
c_firewall.guide: Firewall drone. Jams nearby turrets and hack drones. Break it first.

neural.name: Neural Overclock
neural.desc: 2x attack speed; enemies and their bullets at 0.5x speed

berserk.name: Berserk Mode
berserk.desc: 2x melee damage, +20% move speed, heal 2 HP per kill

cloak.name: Optical Camo
cloak.desc: Every enemy, bosses included, loses track of you; no damage while cloaked

orbital.name: Orbital Strike
orbital.desc: 4 huge blasts on every on-screen enemy over 10 seconds

0.text: {runner}, you got the ripperdoc's reminder, right? Miss the interest this week and he takes that arm back.

1.text: Nobody hires a zero-point citizen. Nobody but me.

2.text: Here's the job. Carlo Basili, gang boss of the Lower Slums. He sells protection in the blocks CENSUS gave up on. Take him out.

4.text: Finish the whole job and it's gone. Hold out about ten minutes and Basili will come for you himself.

0.text: Basili's down. Seen the news? "Slum security vacuum, AI management failure." You're tonight's headline.

1.text: I'm keeping his ledger. Call it a hobby.

2.text: Next job. The Industrial Zone factory is building XM-4 war mechs for Black Shield. Stop the line.

3.text: Past the factory checkpoint your weapons get confiscated and your mods get locked. My inside man will slip in your main weapon and one piece of gear.

4.text: You want me to walk into a mech factory empty-handed?

5.text: Close to it. And watch the floor conveyors. They'll drag you along.

2.name: Corporate Tower
2.ruleHint: When red lines blink, security lasers sweep through

0.text: The XM-4 is scrap. Tonight's headline: "Arconan factory accident, AI security failure." The council is getting loud.

3.text: Last one. The city management AI at the top of the corporate tower. CENSUS. Shut it down.

4.text: Security Director Nora Vail runs the lobby. The checkpoint is worse than the factory's. Same deal: main weapon and one piece of gear.

5.text: And this chip. The moment CENSUS goes dark, plug it in. Don't ask.

6.text: Laser grids sweep the tower. When the red lines flash, move.

thug.name: Tower Guard
thug.guide: Tower guards. Arconan wage-earners with batons. Keep your distance.

gunner.name: Security Officer
gunner.guide: Security officers. Rifles from range. Sidestep and take them out first.

corrupt_cop.name: Security Shotgunner
corrupt_cop.guide: Shotgunners. Three shells in a fan. Don't stand in front.

psycho.name: Augmented Security Officer
psycho.guide: Augmented officers. Bodies rebuilt on company money. When one pauses it charges. Dash sideways.

lines.0: The company paid for this body.

rat_bot.name: Quadruped Bot
rat_bot.guide: Quadruped bots. Tower patrols that come in packs. Fast but fragile.

0.text: CENSUS is dark. You plugged the chip in? ...Good.

2.text: Northridge Holdings' install key for the new AI. Tomorrow morning the council signs an emergency contract.

3.text: Your debt's settled, like I promised. Good work, {runner}.

4.text: The city always belongs to someone. This time it's my company.

5.text: And the slums on the new scoreboard?

6.text: At the bottom. Same as always.

3.title: Black Shield War Mech XM-4 Swarmhound
